key_facts_table: New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC), Ministry of Home Affairs
**05 nos.** CNG operated new Mechanical Road Sweepers (Truck Mounted) – supply, testing & commissioning
Two Packet (Technical + Financial); **total value wise**; no reverse auction

rows: 18.08.2025, 15:00 Hrs – Office of Chief Engineer (Civil-I), 16th Floor, Palika Kendra

items.text: Documents required: experience criteria, bidder turnover, certificates (as per ATC), **OEM authorisation**, OEM annual turnover.
==**MSEs:** exempt from experience and turnover criteria== (Udyam proof to be uploaded); EMD exemption only for MSE **manufacturers**, not traders.
**Startups:** no exemption from experience and turnover.
Bidders from countries sharing a land border with India must be registered with the Competent Authority.
Minimum local content: **50%** for Class-1 and **20%** for Class-2 local supplier; OEM certificate of local content required.
MSE purchase preference: MSE quoting within **L1 + 15%** may match L1 and get **25%** of the quantity.
==**Option clause:** quantity may be increased or decreased by up to **25%** at contract stage, and increased by up to 25% during the contract at the same rates.==
Bid splitting: not applied. Inspection by GeM-empanelled agency: not required.
Auto-extension: bid extends by **7 days** unless at least 1 bid is received.

rows: O/o Chief Engineer (Civil-I), 15th Floor, NDMC, Palika Kendra, New Delhi-110001

summary: NDMC is buying 5 CNG truck-mounted mechanical road sweepers through GeM bid GEM/2025/B/6540437, closing 01.09.2025 at 18:00 Hrs. EMD is ₹11,09,205 and ePBG 5% for 12 months, with strong preference for MSEs and Make in India suppliers (50% local content for Class-1). OEM authorisation and the experience/turnover documents in the ATC decide eligibility for non-MSE bidders.

key_facts.quote: L-1+ 15% (Selected by Buyer) of margin of purchase preference
L-1 price and contract will be awarded for 25%
increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity
